content:
Apple TV has just announced a heist-themed thriller series called 《12 12 12》, set to premiere this fall, starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan. Here are the details and the first trailer.

《12 12 12》is a brand-new heist thriller series starring Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan

Crime thrillers have always been one of Apple TV's flagship genres, and the company has just unveiled a highly anticipated new title centered on an international heist.

《12 12 12》will debut its first two episodes on Friday, November 13, with new episodes dropping weekly through December 25.

The series stars Anthony Mackie and Jamie Dornan, and its title refers to the 12 months needed to plan the heist, the 12 hours to execute the operation, and the 12-day window to evade capture afterward.

Here's the official synopsis, along with the first trailer:

If you enjoy crime thrillers, Apple TV's fall slate has several other notable titles in the same vein.

《Last Seen》premieres in September, following a retired cop whose daughter reappears after vanishing a decade ago. Then in October comes 《Nocturne》, starring Liev Schreiber as a homicide detective going up against a serial killer.

Will you be tuning in when 《12 12 12》debuts? Let us know in the comments.

Apple TV costs $12.99 per month, and you can also bundle it through Apple One for a discounted price.
